name: pumi-acp
description: Coding agents over ACP (Agent Client Protocol) in panes of their own, drawn as a chat: Claude, Codex, pi, Gemini, OpenCode, Copilot or any ACP agent. Each pane is an agent like a terminal's, and its agent outlives the app.

agents.label: Agents
agents.desc: More ACP agents, or replacements for the shipped ones, by id: `command`, `args`, `env`, and optionally `name`, `login` (a command line that signs in) and `resume` (the agent's TUI resuming `{session}`).

bun.label: Bun
bun.desc: The Bun that runs each pane's host process. Empty: the app's own.

commands.title: ACP: continue this terminal agent as an ACP pane
